active_cognition_overlap: hypotheses already model evidence/revision/plans but do not persist user-stated currentness/revocation facts as claims
working memory packets carry evidence refs but not durable claim lifecycle
authority_overlap: authority evaluators classify actions; pilot can preserve explicit revocation facts but is not enforcement yet
discourse_overlap: discourse frame routes user requests, but does not supersede/revoke prior operator facts
memory_overlap: memory candidates/canonical memory exist elsewhere; pilot does not write canonical memory and should not make chat rigid
risk: Broad semantic classification would duplicate cognition and risk brittle chat behavior; deterministic opt-in subset has bounded value.
